reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves Client's freedom to acquire, develop, license or use competing software and services, subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and confidentiality — this exceeds the playbook's preferred position of 'no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer'.

The Section 2(a) license-scope language ('in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting...') is correctly characterised as a scope limit on permitted use of TrueLink's Interface, not a field-of-use restraint on Customer's business activities.

Section 8(d)'s reference to the 'Non-Competition Agreement' is correctly read as a limitation on TrueLink's license to use Credit Data, i.e. a restraint on the vendor, which the rule expressly permits; the finding appropriately flags diligence on the undefined cross-referenced agreement rather than overreaching with a redline.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
